interview.name: Faye
interview.answer: The repair drive is set for 3:30 at the community center front steps.

reflections: Faye is a practical coordinator who focuses on logistics and timing, especially around the school schedule.
Jules is leading the repair drive planning and is relying on Faye for schedule support.
Tess is informed and supportive, and seems to be keeping an eye on progress without driving decisions.
Faye is coordinating logistics carefully around school pickup timing.
Tess is tracking the repair drive and expects only minor remaining tasks.
Sam is helping by organizing donations so the handoff is smoother.
Faye is coordinating timing and logistics across the group and keeps checking details before confirming plans.
Sam is reliable on the hands-on task and quickly volunteers to organize donated items by category.
Leo and Cleo are responsive collaborators who wait for confirmation and provide supporting information so the plan can be finalized.
Faye is coordinating logistics carefully and keeps others updated as timing details firm up.
Cleo is responsive and task-oriented, contributing supply checks and concise follow-up.
The group is converging on a shared plan centered on the 3:30 community center handoff and repair drive.
Faye is coordinating a shared repair drive and repeatedly checks timing details before confirming logistics.
Eli is organized and action-oriented, helping narrow the plan by proposing a specific meeting spot and a small confirmed repair list.
Nell and Ira are supportive, staying informed and offering to monitor for changes rather than driving decisions.

events.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive—what time window are you thinking?
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — that’d help a lot. I’m thinking a late afternoon window, maybe 3:30 to 5:30, so folks can swing by after pickup.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Faye: That should work well — I’ll check the school pickup timing and see if we can keep the drive open in that 3:30 to 5:30 window.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely — folks are pitching in and the list of fixes is getting shorter by the day.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Faye: That’s great to hear — I’ve been trying to keep track of the school pickup times around it, so I’m glad it’s moving along. If you hear what still needs doing, let me know.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Tess: Absolutely, I will — last I heard, it’s mostly a few odds and ends now. I’ll keep my ears open and tell you if anything major comes up.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Faye: That window should work—I’ll check the school pickup timing and make sure we can keep it open from 3:30 to 5:30.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Mina: Thanks — can you also tell me whether the repair drive has started, or are donations still coming in?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Faye: I’m not sure it’s fully started yet — last I heard donations were still coming in, but it’s getting close. I’ll check and let you know what’s set up.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated items and set them by category.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Faye: Great, thanks — that’ll make things much smoother. I’ll keep the 3:30 to 5:30 window in mind around pickup.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll have everything sorted and ready before pickup.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Faye: I’m still checking the school pickup timing, but the 3:30 to 5:30 window still looks like the best bet for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Leo: That works for me — please confirm the pickup timing when you can. I’ll plan around 3:30 to 5:30 for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll confirm the pickup timing and keep the repair drive set for 3:30 to 5:30 if everything lines up.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now and I’ll send the short list as soon as I know what we’re missing.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — that helps. Once you send the list, I’ll line it up with the school pickup window and see what works.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Cleo: I’ll get that short list to you soon, and then we can match it to the pickup window.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Faye: I’m still checking the school pickup timing, but 3:30 to 5:30 still looks like the best bet for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Kira: Okay, can you confirm the drop-off spot too? I just want to make sure everything’s clear before people start bringing things by.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Faye: Yes — I’ll confirm the drop-off spot and send it along once I’ve checked with the school timing. 3:30 to 5:30 still looks like the best window for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Faye: I’m still checking the school pickup timing, but 3:30 to 5:30 still looks like the best window for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Eli: That works for me. Let’s meet at the community center front steps at 3:30, and I’ll bring the confirmed repair list and keep it small.
events.speaker: Eli

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll keep the repair drive set for 3:30 at the community center front steps and confirm the school timing if anything changes.
